name: How do plumbers clear a main sewer line clog?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers clear a main sewer line clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers use several methods to clear main sewer line clogs. Initially, they might attempt to clear it with a professional-grade auger or snake, which can break through many common obstructions. If the clog is severe or its exact nature is unknown, a sewer camera inspection is often performed to identify the cause and location precisely. For stubborn blockages like tree roots or heavy grease, hydro jetting, which uses high-pressure water to scour the inside of the pipe, is very effective. In rare cases of collapsed or severely damaged pipes, excavation and repair or replacement may be necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers typically clear main sewer line clogs using professional augers, sewer camera inspections, or hydro jetting. Severe damage may require pipe repair.
